title: Interview surface visual
description: A visual declared by format, never by the skill that produced it. `kind` is the v2.1 name for `format` and is read as an alias. `file` is a path relative to the data dir.

label.description: A short tab name; the page falls back to `title`, then `id`

group.description: Visuals that share a group are alternatives or versions of one another

primary.description: At most one live primary visual per group within a scope

archived.description: Set by archive-visual; the page never shows an archived visual
